## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The invite validator still accepts 8-character passwords, which breaks the twelve-character policy that the pull-request body says this change enforces. It should be fixed before merge.

## Changes
The pull request raises `MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH` from 8 to 12 in `app/signup.py` and `app/reset.py`. It moves the boundary tests in `tests/test_signup.py` and `tests/test_reset.py` to 11, 12 and 13, and it adds a `review.txt` file.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/signup.py:1 — correctness — Raise the invite flow minimum to twelve too — An 11-character password is still accepted through `app.invite.accepts_password`, because the stale `app/invite.py:1` keeps `MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH = 8` while this change raises only signup and reset to 12. The pull-request body says it raises "the minimum in the password validators", and `tests/test_invite.py:6` still asserts the 8-character boundary. — Users who join through an invitation can still set passwords shorter than the twelve characters the security policy requires. — Fix: Set `app/invite.py:1` to 12 and extend `tests/test_invite.py::test_password_boundaries` with the same 11/12/13 boundaries.
